analysis_title: MIRA Learned-Weight Stability, Sensitivity, and Robustness Analysis

Low Regularization (lambda_reg <= 0.05).characteristics: Specification weight collapses to 0.0; semantic weight dominates (> 0.46); L2 distance to baseline is large (0.42 - 0.49).
Low Regularization (lambda_reg <= 0.05).safety_assessment: UNSAFE. Causes severe false high scores on hard negatives (up to 22.7% scoring >= 0.80).

Medium Regularization (0.10 <= lambda_re.characteristics: Transition zone. Specification weight begins recovering (0.00 -> 0.04), grade weight stabilizes (0.01 -> 0.04), L2 distance drops (0.39 -> 0.31).
Medium Regularization (0.10 <= lambda_re.safety_assessment: MARGINALLY SAFER (zero HN >= 0.80), but specification weight remains depressed (< 0.05), risking subtle specification mismatch misses.

High Regularization (lambda_reg >= 0.50).characteristics: Defensible stable anchor zone. Specification weight is well preserved (0.12 - 0.22), grade weight is preserved (0.08 - 0.11), L2 distance is small (0.17 - 0.06).
High Regularization (lambda_reg >= 0.50).safety_assessment: SAFE. Zero HN >= 0.80; mean HN score is controlled (0.50 - 0.52); HELDOUT ROC-AUC (0.82 - 0.83) shows solid generalization.

Hard-Negative Penalized (lambda_reg=0.10.characteristics: Forces HN scores below 0.50 threshold while allowing medium regularization. Increases grade weight (up to 0.14) and reduces other_attributes to 0.0.
Hard-Negative Penalized (lambda_reg=0.10.safety_assessment: SAFE against hard negatives (mean HN score 0.45 - 0.48, zero >= 0.80), but completely suppresses other_attributes similarity.
